title: Hearty Light French Burrata Tarte Tatin
description: A kid-friendly French dish featuring burrata, this tarte tatin is a twist on the classic recipe, made with a copper mug and FODMAP-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
Add the sliced apples to the bowl and toss to coat with the sugar mixture.
In a copper mug, arrange a layer of apples.
Dot the top of the apples with butter.
Cut the burrata cheese into small pieces and layer on top of the apples.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and cream.
Pour the egg mixture over the burrata cheese.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of apples on top.
Bake the tarte tatin in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the tarte tatin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
